intent: Rendere immediatamente comprensibili priorità, responsabilità, autorità, effetti, intervento AI, conferma umana ed evidenze, mantenendo la superficie visiva compatta.
benchmarks: NIST CSF 2.0 outcome-oriented governance and risk communication
NIST SSDF 1.1 secure development and release evidence
WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented interaction, focus, target and predictable help
EU human oversight and transparency expectations for AI-assisted workflows

personas.goal: Capire in meno di un minuto dove si trova, cosa deve fare e cosa succede dopo.
Registrare fatti o materiale senza dover formulare una conclusione giuridica.
Configurare, approvare e governare cambi di stato con effetti e ricevute espliciti.
Ricostruire identità, capacità, operazioni, effetti, limiti e prove senza disporre di azioni di scrittura.

definitionOfDone: Home answers what, why now, why me, how, outcome, AI role, human checkpoint and evidence.
Home also exposes identity, access mode, allowed actions, forbidden actions, state effects and evidence trail from the server-issued profile.
Auditor sees an open authority map and no write affordance.
Materiale, Fonte and Evidenza are never used as synonyms.
Navigation and headings use plain Italian without decorative numbering.
Decision capsule is at most 330 px high in the reference desktop viewport while retaining 44 px targets.
Version 1.4.0 is propagated across runtime, package metadata, claims and documentation.
All contract, runtime, browser and security jobs pass on one exact commit.
The N+100 tail introduces zero new behavioral primitive in the declared model.
claimBoundary: Repository and selected runtime/browser assurance only. No legal opinion, production deployment certification or complete human accessibility audit is implied.
